notes: Three model-volcano planning briefs matched to the existing nine rubric criteria. All copied layout cells are duplicated planning forms,not separate student questions. Students choose one actual variable/experiment;three brainstorm examples are options,not three mandatory investigations. Baking-soda/vinegar CO2model does not reproduce magma or geological eruption mechanisms. Original29rubric marks retained,with26task marks and3grammar/spelling. Missing-brief review remains visible in earlier canonical framework pending teacher selection of an actual experiment.
